target_surface: personal todo landing, auth, and authenticated dashboard direction exploration
goal: Help the team choose a dashboard information architecture that makes private list and task work clear, fast, and resilient at desktop and narrow viewports.
primary_user: A signed-in individual managing personal tasks across a small set of private lists.
critical_tasks: open the private workspace and identify the active list
capture a task with a note
load another bounded page of records
constraints: preserve todo, in_progress, and done status semantics
preserve completed-task visibility and filtering behavior
preserve bounded pagination and destructive-action meaning
use the same fixture and capabilities in every direction
keep prototypes isolated from production routes, APIs, schemas, migrations, and dependencies
